Home/ Tickets & Registration

The 2026 passes.

Registration is closed. These are the original pass categories for Élan Summit 2026. All student passes include access to the event flow, cultural moments, networking blocks, and participation in your chosen flagship, Crisis Command or Cent$ible, subject to registration category and capacity.

These passes belong to the 2026 edition.
Dates and prices for the next edition have not been announced.

Next-edition information ↗

Day Delegate

₹2,800
  • Full delegate access across both days
  • Eligibility to compete in Crisis Command or Cent$ible
  • Keynotes, performances and competitions
  • Certificate of participation
  • Accommodation and transport not included. For participants making their own arrangements
Registration closed

Registration closed on 30 August 2026, or earlier if capacity is reached. The Early Bird, Standard and Late Registration passes include accommodation for the night of 5 September and transport in Pune between your accommodation and the venue. The Day Delegate pass does not include accommodation or transport, and is for participants making their own arrangements. Travel to Pune itself is your own arrangement on every pass. Participants travelling from Kolhapur can travel with the Élan team at an additional charge, as the team travels from Kolhapur. Where accommodation is included, only one night’s stay is covered. Additional nights can be arranged at extra cost, but must be requested well in advance; requests made close to the event, or on the day, may not be possible.

How registration worked in 2026.

A clear path from payment to portal.

Registration is only the start. Here is exactly what happens once you pay, and how your access unlocks.

Step 1

Submit your details

Complete the registration form with your information.

Step 2

Complete payment

Pay securely for your selected pass.

Step 3

Registration verified

Your payment is verified by the Élan team.

Step 4

Receive your Élan UID

Your permanent participant identity is issued.

Step 5

Activate your portal

Set your password from a secure link.

Step 6

Everything unlocks

Ticket, detailed schedule, participant guide, and updates go live in the portal.

Your UID becomes your official Élan participant identity for the event.
